notes: πᾶς ὁ splits because the ASV writes a second English word for the article: 'every' to the quantifier, 'one' to the article, 'that putteth away' to the participle (rules 32, 80).
μοιχεύει → 'committeth adultery' headed on 'adultery', the root μοιχ- being what that word glosses while 'committeth' is the empty support verb (rule 91).
